_comment: The backend has no separate Category entity/endpoint -- 'category' is a free-text field on Product, filterable via GET /api/products?category=. This file documents the category values used consistently across dummy-data/products/products.json, so the frontend's category filter has a stable, known set of values to demo against.

categories.name: Widgets
categories.description: The original example category from the backend's own README.
